user.title: Remote Calendar Retain
user.description: Configure the remote iCalendar feed. Disabling retention discards stored history after the next successful refresh.

data_description.calendar_name: The calendar name shown in Home Assistant.
data_description.url: An HTTP, HTTPS or webcal iCalendar feed URL.
data_description.retain_events: Keep deleted or cancelled events that started or start in less than one minute when a refresh detects the deletion. History survives restarts.
data_description.username: Optional HTTP Basic Authentication username. Clear both credential fields to remove authentication.
